title: Apply to install a street awning or business sign
summary: This page explains the requirements and processes for applying to install a street awning or a business sign.
intro:
If you want to install an awning over any part of a public road or footpath, you need to apply for approval from your local council and obtain a complying development certificate.

If you want to install a business sign over any part of a public road or footpath, you need to apply for approval from your local council. This includes wall signs, fascia signs, under-awning signs, top hamper signs, temporary signs and public art.
